data.one_liner: A multi-point mesh gradient that extends Gradient and can be used in decorations and animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a MeshGradient class that works similarly to RadialGradient and LinearGradient, supporting up to 8 colors with customizable offsets, strengths, and sigmas. It also includes MeshGradientContainer and AnimatedMeshGradientContainer widgets for building static or animated mesh gradient backgrounds.
use_when: You want to add multi-point mesh gradients to your Flutter app UI.
You need an animated gradient background that shuffles colors periodically.
You want to use a custom gradient inside standard decorations like BoxDecoration.
avoid_when: You are running on Android emulators using Impeller OpenGLES where the shader is currently not working.
You prefer simple linear or radial gradients built natively into Flutter without shaders.
strengths: Supports up to 8 colors with configurable offsets, strengths, and sigmas.
Supports lerping for smooth animations with BoxDecoration and AnimatedContainer.
Includes ready-to-use container widgets for quick implementation.
weaknesses: Requires shader precaching or initialization at app startup.
Shader compatibility issues on certain configurations like Impeller OpenGLES on Android emulators.
data.setup_notes: Call await MeshGradient.precacheShader() at app startup in main().
